RS §14.2a now derives only validated explicit links and applicable owning-log sequence order. Duplicate/ambiguous identities never become last-map-wins targets. Correction retains same-kind/paired reason/exact target; original and correction remain readable. Missing target unknown; invalid kind/reason nonconformant; self/cyclic/contradictory links establish no replacement. Incomparable competing corrections/dispositions remain readable contenders with derived ambiguous/unresolved diagnostic, no UUID/path/enumeration/time total order or silent erasure. Same capture in another writer record is not a later act. Clear ordinary single-log/evidenced-link cases remain derivable; unrelated records remain usable. R1–R8, append-only history, FC8 resolution limits, no writes on read, and unsealed provenance/no-act-admission remain unchanged.

**Existing basis:** RS §13.1 S-A says each writer's order is its own and view merges logs; §13.2 seq is log-local; W3 and OF5 demand new same-kind correction naming target with reason; R6 builds corrected-by, R8 latest/one-capture/disagreement and no read writes. DV6 requires later act supersession versus correction and lists RV8/RV9; it does not define cross-log total order. Current local prototype uses last-wins by_id/corrected_by dictionaries and detects only kind mismatch for resolved targets; that implementation evidence establishes ordinary fixtures, not a broader authority rule.

**Owning agreement needed:** interpretation is source-consistent for single-log/link-warranted cases, but applying its ambiguous-current result to DV6 must be agreed by the owning RS/DV Designs and independently checked rather than unilaterally narrowing “latest” to filesystem order. Parent routes DV owner concurrence; inactive Group D source is not edited here. Carry downstream notice in Group D work graph when that loop exists, retaining the requirement in current Group A meanwhile. Manager records CI12 separately. No new human gate inferred from this ordinary technical ambiguity rule.

**Exact proposed DV receiving sentence for agreement:** “Later/latest is derived only where validated explicit links and applicable writer-local sequence/source evidence establish the relation. Incomparable competing current decisions or corrections remain readable claims with ambiguous/unresolved standing; no path/UUID/enumeration total order is inferred. A correction is not a new person decision and does not erase its target.”

**Checking:** source consistency compared S-A/seq/W3/R6/R8, FC8, DV6 and prototype dictionary logic. No implementation test or completed adoption claimed. Existing canonical FC5a app-run correction 0009→0015/RV8/RV9 retains both and normal replacement; FC5b wrong-kind/INV-RS7 no-reason remains no effect. Future exact negatives: missing or duplicate target, self/cycle, divergent cross-log corrections and competing dispositions with no causal order; all readable contenders retained, visible unknown, no map-last winner/read write. A valid ordered single-log control and explicit unambiguous linked control must still derive ordinary result. Source/schema shapes unchanged; do not replace original oracles to fit implementation.

## CI12 implementation source supplement — P0 admitted writer stream

Initial targeted reader repair deliberately refused to infer a later capture from seq alone, but the unchanged `older_pending_act_precedes_fresh_confirmation_and_latest_decision_stays_latest` oracle exposed the missing existing P0 producer warrant: first test run act_storage 23/24, decision alternative null versus expected ALT-2 at act_storage.rs:821. No oracle changed. P0 ActControl::flush_native_locked sorts its PRIVATE admitted native-capture ordinals (untrusted cold files never enter that queue); records::write_pending preserves its reserved ID/original observedAt and APP_INTERFACE writer; earlier admission/delay account completes before fresh continuation. RS W2 retains observedAt/order and W3 explicit correction semantics remain distinct.

The reader now consumes this bounded SOURCE-REPORTED observation-stream claim when both records state direct A16 capture under the same APP_INTERFACE writer in one complete owning log, original observedAt equals that record's captureTime, captures are distinct, and there is no correction masquerading as a new performance. It orders those recorded claims by the producer's admitted-stream guarantee, never by numerical/lexical timestamps or generic seq. Those fields/identities can be forged: the predicate DOES NOT verify native origin, reconstruct a private ordinal or admit an AdmittedAct/grant. The view explicitly names “reported ordered native capture admission stream; not native-origin verification” and keeps capture provenance unverified. Other seq-only, missing/mismatched marker and cross-log claims remain incomparable. No cold native replay authority or seal is introduced.

This supplement documents an existing reviewed P0 relationship, not a new field/format or native-proof criterion. RS §14.2a bytes remain unchanged; its distinction between recorded observation order and performance chronology applies. Same independent review/backcheck must assess the actual producer/warrant and ensure a current projection names only this reported meaning. Exact reader tests cover equal clock strings, missing/mismatched markers and matching forgeable markers across different logs; the latter never creates global/native authority. Full P0 and cold-file negatives are retained unchanged.

## Residual history-reference clarification — independent CI12 finding

Global ambiguous/unresolvable record identity rules also govern observations used to establish past lapse/restoration. A raw body under a conflicting observation ID is not one resolved history fact merely because it individually matches kind/referent/c0. Preserve all original observation claims and exact owning log/seq attribution; exclude unresolved IDs/relations from resolved history. If the past dependency is unresolved, report past history unknown/incomplete rather than converting absence of usable history into not-lapsed or matches-again. Current content identity/comparison is a separate known or unknown fact and remains visible. Same agreeing capture recorded through several IDs shares this unresolved dependency; aggregate and each alias do not silently drop it. Identical unchanged observation copies resolve one unchanged claim with all sources retained. This applies existing R1/R6/R8 source limits, with no new RS field/kind/format/native admission or observer authority.

## Independent qualifying-witness preservation — R1 source backcheck refinement

The c76 R1 implementation correctly excluded conflicting observation IDs but conservatively masked restoration even where a separate unambiguous qualifying prior-lapse observation existed. Reviewer explicitly required distinguishing incomplete total history from independently established existential prior lapse. Preserve the original duplicate-only unknown result and every conflicted raw body/limit, but allow the separate good-ID witness to warrant prior lapse/current match. Resolved history contains only good IDs; no conflicting body is used. State “established prior lapse; history incomplete” rather than falsely claiming complete history or suppressing the warranted recorded fact. If no qualifying resolved witness exists, past remains unknown/unresolvable. Current content and native-origin limits remain independent. Same agreeing capture aliases/aggregate use the same distinction.
